name: profutbol-antigua
description: Sistema de Reservas, Pagos y Gestion Deportiva - Pro Futbol Antigua

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run check:no-dev && npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run check:no-dev && npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
